# AutoTuneMPC examples

- https://api.autotunempc.com
- https://autotunempc.com
- https://autotunempc.com/SKILL.md
- https://api.autotunempc.com/mcp
- claude mcp add --transport http autotunempc https://api.autotunempc.com/mcp

Free: POST /v1/validate
Paid: POST /v1/solve $0.02, POST /v1/autotune $1.50, POST /v1/templates/autotune $2.00
Pack: $29 for 1000 solves and 4 autotunes. A template autotune spends 2 autotune credits.
Human door: X-API-Key. Agent door: HTTP 402 plus PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

Scripts:
- validate.py
- differential_drive.py
- battery_peak_shaving.py
- root_zone_irrigation.py
